name: Runner Extras - Isolated Storage
brief: Proves IsolatedStorage Set/Contains/Get/Delete round-trip through the runner's in-memory repository (the SPBLIC SetAppValue install pattern).
description: RED before the fix: the Cecil-only default left the legacy JmpHook-based isolated-storage replacements uninstalled, so AL IsolatedStorage calls fell through to the REAL Ncl IsolatedStorageRepository, which NREs on the skeleton (no tenant record 2000000107 store) — the exact crash SPBLIC's Extension Setup SetAppValue hit during Pageworks OnInstallAppPerDatabase. GREEN after: the Repository lowest layer is Cecil-rewritten onto TenantStoragePatches' in-memory store, so every higher ALIsolatedStorage entry runs its REAL body and lands here faithfully.
